ios.desc:
# Never miss a deal on the things you love.

See something you love but not ready to buy yet? Save it to Shopie. Create wishlists for anything you find online, and Shopie will track it for you. When the price drops, the size you need is back, or a color returns, you will know right away.

# Save now. Buy later. Buy smarter.

Whether you’re waiting for a price drop, hoping an item comes back in stock, or simply organizing ideas for later, Shopie helps you stay one step ahead — without endless checking.

# Why you will love Shopie:

• Capture items in seconds
  Save products directly from your browser or favorite shopping apps, without copying and pasting links. Spot it, tap share, add to Shopie, and move on with your day.

• Get instant, useful alerts
  Receive notifications when prices drop, stock changes, or important details are updated, so you can buy at the right moment instead of guessing if you are getting a good deal.

• Buy more intentionally
  Track items over time instead of impulse buying. See what still matters after a few days, compare options, and feel confident you are spending on things you truly want.

• Stay effortlessly organized
  Create clear, focused lists like Holiday Gifts, Home Upgrade, Wardrobe, or Just For Fun. Revisit them whenever you are ready to buy, with all your saved items and details in one clean view.

• Share at the right moment
  Send curated wishlists to friends or family when they ask what you want, or share ideas for group gifts, wedding registries, or baby showers without long messages or screenshots.

Shopie runs quietly in the background, checking your saved items around the clock. No clutter. No constant tab switching. Just timely alerts, better timing, and smarter shopping decisions.

Perfect for deal hunters, thoughtful gifters, planners, and anyone who wants to make every purchase count.

# Download Shopie and let the savings come to you.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Shopie: Create Wishlists. Track Prices

quotes.text: Hi HN, I’m Paulo. I’ve spent the last 6 months building Shopie, an iOS app that lets you save products you’re interested in and get notified when prices drop or items come back in stock. It runs entirely on-device using iOS background tasks, requires no account, and stores all data locally (or in iCloud if enabled). It’s been useful for finding real deals and avoiding impulse buys. Feedback welcome.
